text_block_list.text: A short while before taking on the Nakayama Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I heard from Verxina.
You want to hear about what it was like in Dubai, right?

Thanks to Verxina's recommendation, I decided to ask
Hokko Tarumae—an Umamusume who had experienced
an overseas campaign—about how it was at the time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, please tell me!
Like, how did it feel...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Only if you're okay with it, Tarumae-san!

When I had Verxina examined before,
the doctor mentioned her name as well, but—
Hokko Tarumae is an Umamusume who primarily races on dirt and holds a glorious record of 10 GⅠ victories. She is also Verxina's roommate.

She previously challenged an overseas expedition... only to suffer a crushing defeat.
Though she had maintained a great record until then, she was forced into a lengthy period of recovery after returning home.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm fine!
Back then, it was definitely tough, though.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right.
You had a pretty long break, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
In the end, it took over half a year.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It was terrible. Right around the time
I was winning like 5 GⅠ races domestically, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I thought, 'With this momentum, I can do it!' and tried taking on races overseas, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...It was really tough.
I'd heard about it, but the environment and everything else were completely different."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Is it really that different?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, very much so. I'm feeling pretty high-strung myself,
being in such an unfamiliar environment...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I fell sicker than I ever had before.
Even after returning home, it took a lot of effort to recover.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In the end, 5th place was the best she could do in Dubai.
On top of that, she had wasted an invaluable period of time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't challenged them, maybe I could've
extended my win streak even further...
Even thoughts like that crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course, taking on the challenge was meaningful in itself,
and I don't regret it at all! But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Verxina-san
that you're aiming for Dubai too, Vivlos-chan.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still... if there's even a little bit of anxiety,
I think it might be better not to rush it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even going in peak condition, it was tough...
At least for me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Your dream is important, but make sure to take care of yourself too, okay?
I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
thank you, Tarumae-san!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to hear
what Tarumae-san had to say!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard about you from my big sister,
but you really are so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
I can be careless sometimes... too, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"So when you tell anyone about me,
be sure to say,
'She has nothing to hide and she's super cute!'... okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
?
Yep♪

—And at last, race day arrived.
Depending on how she runs today, we will decide whether we can embark on our overseas expedition to Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

Because this would be a crucial match for the future,
Vivlos also seemed a little nervous.
choice_data_list: (I want to help her relax a little.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Giggle...
You really are such a spoiled sweetie.

"Come to think of it, whenever Vivlos
is pampering someone or acting spoiled,
she always looks so relaxed."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Is there anything you want me to do?
Is there anything you'd like me to do?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Something you want me to do...?
choice_data_list: I'll grant you just one wish.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Give me a hug, then!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *pat pat!*

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehhー!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
None of them work?
Then don't even ask me in the first place~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, I guess.
Trainy, open your arms wide, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And then, hug the air in front of you tight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Air hug! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
I just got all powered up♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Keep your eyes on me.
Watch me run...!
